verdict: This outfit screams 'I will fail you by 0.1% and sleep like a baby on a pile of unread research papers.'
detailedQuote: The washed-out grey button-down coupled with those oversized vintage specs tells me everything I need to know about his 8:00 AM attendance policy. He definitely spends the first 20 minutes of class solving abstract differential equations on the blackboard in complete, menacing silence.

inventory.name: Light grey button-down shirt of absolute tenure-track apathy
inventory.description: A pale, lifeless grey button-up shirt so devoid of personality it looks like it was woven from old syllabus papers and unfulfilled department promises.

inventory.name: Clear oversized aviator glasses of pop-quiz surveillance
inventory.description: Translucent retro-frame glasses engineered specifically to maximize glare while staring down students who dare to ask if the exam is curved.
